# q[3]       : phase target ancilla

# Compute condition onto workspace ancilla, kick back phase on q[3], then uncompute.

circuit.h(q[3])

# Compute two-input AND onto workspace ancilla using CCX
circuit.ccx(q[0], q[1], q[2])

# Use workspace ancilla to control phase target ancilla
circuit.cx(q[2], q[3])

# Apply phase oracle
circuit.z(q[3])

# Uncompute workspace and phase-ancilla entanglement
circuit.cx(q[2], q[3])
circuit.ccx(q[0], q[1], q[2])

circuit

    prep.h(qr[i])

measure_y.compose(prep, inplace=True)

    measure_y.h(qr[i])

qc.cp(math.pi/2, q[2], q[1])

qc.h(q[1])

qc.barrier()

qc.h(q[0])
qc.cp(-math.pi/2, q[1], q[0])
qc.h(q[1])
qc.cp(-math.pi/4, q[2], q[0])
qc.cp(-math.pi/2, q[2], q[1])
qc.h(q[2])

# Measure all qubits
qc.measure(q, c)
